title: Project RimFactory half-copied, shows as anonymous189 junk
symptom: About 140 'Could not load reference' lines for PRF_* and RR_Book_PRF_* defs. In the mod list PRF showed as anonymous189.2033979700 with 'Game versions: none' and no description.
cause: The install copy timed out mid-folder and left 596 of 1,925 files with no About.xml, so the game loaded the folder as an anonymous mod instead of PRF. Every mod patching PRF then failed to find its defs.
fix: Deleted and re-copied the folder from the workshop cache, checked file count against the source, and added spdskatr.projectrimfactory to the list. A mod showing as 'Author: Anonymous, versions: none' is a corrupt folder, not a broken mod.

title: Filth Creates Trash: 90 'trashType must be declared' errors
symptom: 90 config errors, one per filth def from every mod: trashType must be declared.
cause: Filth Creates Trash patches filth to drop Vanilla Recycling Expanded items (VRecyclingE_*). Its About.xml does declare VRE as a dependency, but the installer resolved that dependency to the wrong workshop item, so VRE was never active and every trashType resolved to null.
fix: Installed Vanilla Recycling Expanded (workshop 3155781848) and checked its defNames match what the mod references. No patch needed.

title: Signs and Comments: 18 impassable-with-low-fill errors
symptom: 18 config errors on decorative sign defs.
cause: Several sign defs are marked Impassable with a low fillPercent, which 1.6 flags as a contradiction.
fix: A small patch mod loaded last (Modlist Compatibility Fixes) sets those signs to PassThroughOnly.

title: Missing research VFE_IndustrialGenerators
symptom: Three mods referenced a research project that did not exist.
cause: The research project lives in Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Power, which was not installed.

title: Two camera mods active at once
cause: Two camera mods doing the same job.

title: Two Giddy-Up forks active at once
cause: Two forks of the same mod define the same things.
fix: Kept Giddy-Up 2 Continued, disabled the owlchemist fork.

title: While You're Up, Smart Speed and Hunt For Me throw on 1.6
symptom: Harmony patch exceptions at startup from While You're Up and Smart Speed. Hunt For Me reported an illegal defName.
cause: All three list 1.6 in supportedVersions, but their patches fail on 1.6, so the mods load and do nothing. Each is covered by something else in the list: Pick Up And Haul for While You're Up, the built-in speed controls for Smart Speed, Colony Manager for auto-hunting.

title: 'Fallback handler could not load library' lines
symptom: Lines like: Fallback handler could not load library data-0x...dll
signature: Fallback handler could not load library
cause: Unity/Mono noise under heavy Harmony patching.
fix: None needed, and none possible from a mod.

title: Every log line carries a stack trace on 1.6
symptom: The log looks full of errors because info messages print with a stack trace underneath.
cause: RimWorld 1.6 prints a stack trace under every Log.Message, including plain info.
fix: Read the first line of each block, not the trace. Turn off Development mode to hide the rest.

title: Settings class migration messages
symptom: Messages about a mod settings file that could not be loaded into the current settings class.
cause: The mod renamed its settings class between versions and the old Config/Mod_*.xml file no longer matches.
fix: Deleted the stale Config/Mod_<id>_*.xml files so the mods write fresh ones.
